question: In whose heart does this rare method of yoga abide?
premises: This method of yoga abides in the heart of only some rare person.
It becomes present when the wheel of consciousness becomes clear.
Such clarity arises quickly for one who is in his final birth.
inference: This yoga method abides in the heart of a rare person whose consciousness-wheel clears, especially one nearing final birth.
plain_english: This rare method of yoga abides in the heart of someone whose wheel of consciousness becomes clear, quickly, as in the case of one who is in his final birth.
